title: The Specificity Cost of Reducing ECG Lead Information for High-Sensitivity Detection of Occlusion Myocardial Infarction
description: Analysis code and provenance for the prespecified comparison of four ECG lead-information configurations for high-sensitivity detection of angiography-defined occlusion myocardial infarction. The package distinguishes the original pooled OOF development estimate, patient-disjoint A1/A2a calibration checks, same-source blind held-out evaluation, sampling-rate sensitivity, and post hoc matched-TPR analysis. It contains no patient data, hidden labels, model checkpoints, or row-level predictions.
